title: Authentication secret operations
responsibility: Derive separate lookup and encryption keys and generate opaque or human-entered codes.

inputs.name: authSecrets.secret
inputs.description: Session secret used to derive keys; this helper does not enforce its configuration length.

inputs.name: randomToken.bytes
inputs.description: Number of random bytes; defaults to 32.

inputs.name: normalizeCode.value
inputs.description: Code to uppercase and strip to ASCII letters and digits.

outputs.name: authSecrets
outputs.description: Helpers for purpose-bound HMAC lookup hashes and context-bound AES-GCM encryption. open returns null for a malformed value or failed decryption. Keys are derived lazily and retained by the returned helpers.

outputs.name: randomToken
outputs.description: Random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url.

outputs.name: safeEqual
outputs.description: True for equal strings; unequal lengths return immediately, while equal lengths compare every character.

outputs.name: userCode
outputs.description: Eight random characters from the configured unambiguous alphabet, displayed as two groups of four.

outputs.name: normalizeCode
outputs.description: Uppercase ASCII letters and digits with other characters removed.

outputs.name: emailCode
outputs.description: Eight random decimal digits, including leading zeros.
